hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in *src/lsx/*|*scripts/*extract*|*scripts/*factors*|*scripts/*selector*|*tests/test_invariants*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && HF_HOME=$PWD/cache/hf HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_invariants.py 2>&1 | tail -15

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *"git merge"*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$cmd" in *--abort*|*--continue*|*--quit*) exit 0;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; b=$(printf "%s" "$cmd" | grep -oE "worktree-agent-[a-z0-9]+|h[0-9]+-[a-z-]+" | head -1); [ -n "$b" ] || exit 0; git rev-parse --verify "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; stat=$(git diff --stat HEAD.."$b" -- src/lsx scripts 2>/dev/null | tail -12); dif=$(git diff HEAD.."$b" -- src/lsx "scripts/*extract*" "scripts/*factors*" "scripts/*selector*" 2>/dev/null | head -120); [ -n "$stat$dif" ] || exit 0; jq -n --arg s "$stat" --arg d "$dif" --arg b "$b" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",additionalContext:("MEASUREMENT-CODE DIFF for \($b) — read this, not the agent report (CLAUDE.md non-negotiable 5).

" + $s + "

" + $d)}}'

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && echo "--- unresolved (Checkpoint 2) ---" && awk "/^## CHECKPOINT 2/,/^## CHECKPOINT 1/" RESULTS.md | grep -E "still has no null|NOT narrowed|remains open|unre-run|untested|cannot be tested" | sed "s/^ *//" | cut -c1-160 | head -5
